# AI Curated Recent Movies

> New movies you can watch at home, picked by AI every night. Built from TMDB and MDBList data. Same file names and JSON format as the StevenLu popular-movies lists. Updated nightly; poll at most once a day.

Every file is a JSON array of objects with exactly these fields:

- `title` (string)
- `tmdb_id` (integer, The Movie Database id)
- `imdb_id` (string like `tt1234567`, or null in the unranked lists)
- `poster_url` (string URL to a TMDB poster image)
- `genres` (array of snake_case strings, e.g. `science_fiction`)

## Lists

- [movies.json](https://movies.mickschroeder.com/movies.json): 20 movies ranked by AI, best recommendation first
- `https://movies.mickschroeder.com/movies-YYYYMMDD.json`: a dated copy of movies.json for each day since this site started, e.g. `movies-20261123.json`
- [all-movies.json](https://movies.mickschroeder.com/all-movies.json): every movie the ranking chose from, unranked

## Filtered lists

- [movies-metacritic-min50.json](https://movies.mickschroeder.com/movies-metacritic-min50.json): Metacritic score of 50 or more (also `min60`, `min70`, `min80`)
- [movies-imdb-min5.json](https://movies.mickschroeder.com/movies-imdb-min5.json): IMDb rating of 5 or more (also `min6`, `min7`, `min8`)
- [movies-rottentomatoes-min50.json](https://movies.mickschroeder.com/movies-rottentomatoes-min50.json): Rotten Tomatoes score of 50 or more (also `min60`, `min70`, `min80`)
- [movies-rottentomatoes-audience-min50.json](https://movies.mickschroeder.com/movies-rottentomatoes-audience-min50.json): Rotten Tomatoes audience score of 50 or more (also `min60`, `min70`, `min80`)
- [movies-mdblist-min50.json](https://movies.mickschroeder.com/movies-mdblist-min50.json): MDBList score, a blend of all ratings, of 50 or more (also `min60`, `min70`, `min80`)

## Optional

- [Source code](https://github.com/mick-schroeder/movies.mickschroeder.com): MIT licensed, fork of [sjlu/popular-movies](https://github.com/sjlu/popular-movies)
